part.text:
Fixed the `ObservableSwitchMap` inner-observer disposal race in `src/main/java/io/reactivex/rxjava3/internal/operators/observable/ObservableSwitchMap.java`.

`onNext` now reads the inner queue once and only calls `offer` when it was initialized. This safely ignores synchronous emissions made after the inner observer has already been cancelled during `onSubscribe`, preventing the reported `NullPointerException`.
